title: Build from a local checkout through the existing readers
goal: A local build fills every table deterministically
acceptance: Records, steps, owner steps, priorities, `dependsOn` and record-named PRs read through the readers `solution.mjs` and `work-items.mjs` already have (exported where they are; their tests pass unchanged)
Rows inserted in a fixed order; `dump` omits `read_at`; every row carries its source file and commit
F-110-T01's tests pass unchanged; `node:sqlite` only, no new dependency
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented; a token is read from the environment, never written.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the coordinator proposal's 4 h (live index decision page, row S1), failing test first. Not a measurement.
